summary: Build practical microgrid design, modelling, finance, and safety skills. Develop a project-ready distributed energy plan with TrainingCred.
lede: The Design and Operation of Microgrids and Distributed Renewable Energy Systems course shows you how to turn solar resource data, load profiles, battery requirements, tariff rules, and safety obligations into a coherent project design. You will develop practical skills in load forecasting, renewable resource assessment, hybrid system sizing, battery dispatch, protection coordination, tariff interpretation, and lifecycle cost analysis. Using HOMER Pro, PVsyst, structured financial models, and reference points including IEC 62257 and IEEE 1547, you will assess technical, commercial, operational, and regulatory considerations. Workshops help you produce a preliminary design package, commercial model, safety checklist, KPI dashboard, risk register, and implementation roadmap for industrial, commercial, and community energy projects.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, evaluate, finance, regulate, or operate microgrid and distributed renewable energy projects. It suits engineers and decision-makers who need an integrated view of solar, hybrid generation, battery storage, commercial structures, compliance, and safe operations.
prerequisites: You should have a working knowledge of electrical power systems, renewable energy projects, or energy asset operations. Familiarity with solar PV, battery storage, project finance, or utility regulation will help, but you do not need advanced coding skills. Programming is not required for completion. AI-assisted forecasting and digital modelling are taught at operational application level, while electrical design exercises remain preliminary rather than production-engineering certification work.
